features.name: canonical_file_jvm_name_facades
features.scope: Canonical kotlin.jvm.JvmName file annotations, including qualified/import-alias forms and folded constant String names, select the JVM facade owner. Source and compiled module imports, package metadata, annotation retention, duplicate facade diagnostics, and owned-output facade rename/removal are checked.
restrictions: ASCII identifier facade names; existing source filename restrictions remain. Multifile facades, member JvmName, and source annotation type aliases remain explicit unsupported boundaries.

Custom marks.JvmName annotations retain ordinary annotation behavior. The pinned compiler instead renames these facades using short-name matching, including alias and wildcard imports; this observed discrepancy is explicitly separated from differential passes.
No full application, Android runtime, or performance claim.

features.name: private_internal_primary_constructors
features.scope: Private/internal primary constructors of ordinary final nongeneric classes, with source/compiled access checks, same-module and friend-module calls, Kotlin metadata visibility and JVM flags. Private companion, instance, lambda, nested-class and nested-object factories execute under -Xverify:all. Identical nested constructor-access diagnostics survive failed outer overload resolution.
restrictions: Protected, open/abstract, data, inner, value, sealed and explicit enum constructor combinations remain unsupported. Defaults, constructor annotations, secondary constructors and value-class parameter carriers remain unsupported.

Ordinary constructor callable references retain their explicit unsupported boundary. Existing source member-inline rejection can precede validation of oracle-invalid private constructor calls; top-level public-inline/internal constructor leakage is independently rejected.

Java callers compile once against official provider output and execute unchanged against both providers; Kotlin consumers compile independently against each provider, including friend and nonfriend checks. No full application or performance claim.

oracle_discrepancies.evidence: Official javap records marks.JvmName on each renamed class, including import aliases and wildcard imports.
oracle_discrepancies.resolution: Preserve canonical identity and ordinary annotation retention; exclude this case from differential pass counts. Pinned IR FileClassLowering.kt:194-197 compares the annotation constructor parent class name only; the emitted annotation descriptor proves marks.JvmName identity. This is recorded as a suspected oracle bug, not adopted as language behavior.

html_generation: Deferred to parent combined report regeneration.

correctness_repairs.name: nullable_method_annotation_attributes
correctness_repairs.scope: Nullable result annotations use the existing member annotation merger, preserving one attribute per retention and existing parameter/Code attributes.

correctness_repairs.name: canonical_jvmstatic_runtime_retention
correctness_repairs.scope: Canonical JvmStatic remains RUNTIME while JvmOverloads remains BINARY. Exact complete annotation contracts and separate reflection counts check originals, generated overloads and companion bridges.
